blocks.text: Generate and Test algorithm khaas taur par in halaat mein mufeed hai:

items: Problem space (mumkina hal ka daira) chhota ho, to tamam mumkina hal bana kar test karna mumkin ho.
Hal dhoondne ki koi saaf strategy (hikmat-e-amli) na ho, aur exhaustive search (har imkan ki mukammal talash) zaroori ho.
Heuristics ya qawaid se banaye jane wale hal ki tadaad kam ki ja sake, jis se amal zyada efficient ho jaye.

blocks.prompt: 3 hindson (digits) wala lock code 000 se 999 tak aazma kar khul sakta hai. Generate and Test is masle ke liye kyun munasib hai?
blocks.explanation: Problem space chhota hai (1000 mumkina codes) aur har code jaanchna aasan hai, is liye sab aazmana mumkin hai; koi heuristic, jaise pehle zyada imkan wale codes aazmana, ise tez kar sakta hai. Yeh misal samjhane ke liye hai, kitab se nahi.

items: Generate and Test tab istemal karein jab problem space chhota ho, koi behtar strategy na ho, ya heuristics hal ki tadaad kam kar sakein.
